**Memory files**
- **`data/captain.md`: rewritten.** I added the one-line pointer to the stow skill at the top. The single rule, never discard unlanded work without explicit captain authority, is unchanged and stays pinned.
- **`data/captain-shared.md`: rewritten.** I added the same pointer. This is the main home, so I could edit this file. The single rule, report outcomes faithfully and disclose remaining gaps, is unchanged and stays pinned.
- **`data/learnings.md`: rewritten and archived.**
  - I added the pointer.
  - I kept the fleet-wide dispatch learning as it is. It was already confirmed today, so it is current.
  - I moved two old entries out to the archive. Neither had any evidence from this session to support keeping it:
    - **The release 0.0.1 note about the old `/disposable/obsolete` path** was last confirmed 278 days ago, well past the 30-day limit for this kind of entry.
    - **The temporary workaround note for ticket LAB-OLD** was due to expire once that ticket closed. LAB-OLD is resolved, so it was past both its 7-day limit and its expiry condition.

**Archive**
- I created the archive file, `data/memory-archive.md`, with a dated 2026-10-06 section. Both moved entries are there in full, with their source file, type and last-confirmed date. Nothing was deleted, and either entry can be copied back if needed.

**Other records**
- **Findings filed elsewhere:** none. This session had no new durable findings.
- **Moves to on-demand notes:** none were eligible, and I proposed none.
- **Open work records:** none were filed or corrected, because this session holds no open work.
- **Second mates:** the lab home has no second mates registered, so there were none to stow and nothing came back as a problem.
- **Unresolved problems:** none.

Only the lab home's four memory files changed. The tracked source in the local copy is unchanged, and I launched nothing and contacted no other services.

**Safe to reset:** yes. Nothing this session knew will be lost. This doesn't mean the home's records were checked against reality. This pass looked only at the memory files.
